title: Luminous Powder
description: Luminous Powder is primarily a crafting ingredient used in making Luminous Blocks & Luminous Stained Bricks . It is also used to craft Runic Dust and the Spectre Illuminator. However you can also combine it with any enchanted item in a crafting table to make the enchantment glint glow in the dark. The powder is used up and the item gets a yellow "Luminous" line in its tooltip.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: Crafted from glowstone dust, glass and a Glowing Mushroom (makes 4)

properties.label: Used for
properties.value: Luminous Blocks, Luminous Stained Bricks, Runic Dust, Spectre Illuminator

properties.label: Glint
properties.value: Combine with one enchanted item to make its glint glow in the dark
